messages:
Jamal R: seeing sustained SLO burn on inference-hosting-prod, 5m burn spike then sustained higher than expected for ~40m. paging fired twice. not sure customer impact yet, digging logs
Oncall Bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1769993333 - High SLO burn rate on inference-hosting-prod. Pager notification sent to #eng-oncall.
Jamal R: @Alex H are you oncall? can you pick up triage? I can start looking at routing and recent deploys but gotta hand off soon.
Alex H: oncall here. looking at the alert, burn is in the 5m/1h multi-window alert. tokens/sec OK, but tail latency rising around 1.2s. initial hypothesis: a backend worker upgrade caused fewer concurrent model slots -> queueing -> increased observed burn.
Maria T: pinging infra to see if any capacity anomalies. saw some pre-scheduled node maintenance earlier but autoscaler should have covered.
Elena P (product): any sign of customer-facing errors? support queue hasn't flagged major uptick yet but some timed-out requests from partner X.
Jamal R: logs show more 429s and timeouts to model-cache for a subset of customers on ded-tn-gpu-pool. pattern: requests with long context length.
Alex H: ok. immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback recent runtime change (if correlated), 2) temporarily raise concurrency limits for that pool, 3) widen multi-window threshold to avoid more noisy pages while we stabilize.
SRE Pager: escalating to infra-sre for quick capacity change. @infra-sre please advise on option (2) live.
Maria T: infra says they can bump pool size by +10% within 3-5m, but that may cost us and we need approval for dedicated pools.
Elena P (product): if partner X is seeing timeouts, we should prioritize mitigation even if cost rises short-term. please coordinate, notify customers after stabilization.
Alex H: doing quick canary: increasing concurrency on one node in ded-tn-gpu-pool and monitoring. meanwhile I'll lower sensitivity on the 5m burn alert to avoid paging on noisy short-lived spikes. setting new thresholds: 5m burn threshold -> from 8% to 12% for paging, keep slack channel alerting for ops visibility.
Jamal R: document the change in alerting so we can revert, and create an incident note about the temporary threshold change. also, let's make sure multi-windowing still triggers for sustained 1h burn.
Oncall Bot: Alert suppression rule applied: channel-only for Inc-2026-1769993333 for 20m.
Maria T: pool size bump applied, initial telemetry shows tail latency dropping from 1.2s -> 0.7s in test shard. production roll will be gradual.
Alex H: after 12m, production slowdowns reduced, but SLO burn still slightly elevated for long-context flows. suspect KV cache eviction churn due to new kernel.
Jamal R: agree. action item: add a short-term cache pin for top-10 heavy keys to reduce eviction churn. infra says can do as a config toggle.
Elena P (product): can we throttle long-context requests for lower tiers until stable? would avoid impacting partners.
Alex H: we can implement a soft throttle + informative 429 with Retry-After for non-premium routes. rolling policy suggested: 5% throttle on non-reserved customers for requests > 8k tokens.
Maria T: deployed cache pin and throttle rule on a canary subset. monitoring shows error counts fall and 95th latency back to normal.
SRE Pager: confirmed reduction in pages. recommend we keep modified paging criteria until postmortem.
Jamal R: ok let's formalize follow-ups: - revert temporary 5m threshold tweak after stabilization and record in runbook - propose new multi-window policy to product: only page on combined 5m+1h correlation AND traffic-weighted burn above budget - add dedicated dashboard tile for long-context flows and per-pool KV cache eviction rate - write a runbook section for cache churn mitigation (pins, throttle, concurrency adjustments)
Alex H: I'll open a PR for alerting policy changes in monitoring repo with the following proposal in description:
```
- Multi-window alert: require 5m burn > 10% AND 1h burn > 4% AND affected request share > 2% to page.
- If only 5m spike without 1h signal -> channel alert, no page.
- Auto suppression window 30m after actionable mitigation applied.
```
Maria T: adding a note: include cost-safety check for pool bumping - auto-approve if expected spend delta < $X/hour else require oncall ack.
Elena P (product): product ok with soft-throttle for non-premium and wants communications draft for partners.
Jamal R: I'm going to create incident summary doc and schedule a 30m post-incident review with infra and product to decide permanent policy changes.
Oncall Bot: Incident INC-2026-1769993333 status -> mitigated. Actions: create postmortem, alerting PR, dashboard card.
Alex H: thanks everyone. recording final temporary actions: pool +10%, cache-pin, 5m paging threshold increased to 12% (channel-only), soft throttle on long contexts for non-premium.
Maria T: will add dashboard card for KV evictions and long-context share. ETA 2h.
Elena P (product): will draft customer note postmortem and coordinate with support.
Jamal R: assigning follow-ups: @Alex H PR for alert policy, @Maria T dashboard, @Elena P customer comms, @Jamal R postmortem doc. reconvene in review. :thumbsup:
SRE Pager: closing page for now; monitor for 2h.
Alex H: last note - let's add a gating test in canary that simulates high long-context traffic to catch regression before rollout. adding to eng-runtime backlog.
Jamal R: thanks all. I'll paste the incident link once the doc is up: https://redwood.atlassian/incidents/INC-2026-1769993333/postmortem
